notes: Fiscal year ended October 3, 2026, a 53-week year (the 10-K: 'Fiscal 2026 results include the benefit from a fifty-third week of operations'); data.js fy reads 'Sep 2026'. This edition skips fiscal 2025. Filings: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001744489-26-000066, filed November 17, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement filed January 22, 2026 (accession 0001744489-26-000013), the latest proxy, both read on www.sec.gov. WALT DISNEY is deceased. The proxy's stock ownership section lists only Vanguard and BlackRock as 5% holders and no Disney family member, trust or foundation, so family is null. HOLDER DATES: the proxy cites each firm's Schedule 13G/A without giving its date or as-of date, so asOf is null; the share counts are unchanged from the 2025 proxy, so the filings are probably stale. BUYBACKS were $9.0 billion ($3.5 billion in fiscal 2025); dividends were $2.6 billion. STOCK COMP is net of $199 million capitalized. GEOGRAPHY: the Total column of the revenue note (Americas, of which over 90% is the United States; Europe; Asia Pacific), summing to total revenues of $102,344 million. Robert Iger was CEO until Joshua D'Amaro was appointed effective March 18, 2026 (10-K executive officers list).

taxes.notes: Taxes: cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds, from the FY2026 10-K income-tax note by jurisdiction (U.S. federal 2,262, California 207, other state 315, United Kingdom 315, other foreign 817; total 3,916 million). It includes a $1.8 billion payment of fiscal 2025 and part of fiscal 2024 U.S. federal and California taxes deferred under 2025 California wildfire relief, so fiscal 2026 is unusually high. R&D is not reported as a separate line in the FY2026 10-K.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended October 3, 2026, 53 weeks (FY2026 Form 10-K, accession 0001744489-26-000066). Film and TV content spending is inside operating cash flow. Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow; under ASU 2023-09 the 10-K no longer prints them as supplemental cash-flow lines, so taxes come from the income-tax note and interest from the borrowings note. Fiscal 2026 cash taxes include a $1.8 billion payment of fiscal 2025 and part of fiscal 2024 federal and California taxes deferred under 2025 wildfire relief.

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds Disney corporate bonds, in a separate row that is not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the FY2026 10-K cover count at November 11, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate head count at fiscal year end 2026 (October 3, 2026), including part-time and seasonal staff. Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the CEO pay ratio median from the January 2026 proxy is used. It is the median for fiscal 2025 (workforce reviewed as of September 26, 2025; base salary, overtime and the company's health-insurance contribution); the fiscal 2026 median will appear only in the proxy due in January 2027. The CEO pay ratio for fiscal 2025 was 805:1.
